lanes.name: catalog-freshness
lanes.description: Use when checking whether catalogued repos, dependencies, or pinned tools are still maintained - and when deciding what to do about one that has gone stale. Covers running the automated check, reading the result, and replacing an abandoned dependency safely.

lanes.name: cite-or-abstain
lanes.description: Use when producing factual claims that a reader will act on - research summaries, technical answers, market or financial statements, documentation. Requires every non-obvious factual claim to carry an in-context source, and requires explicit abstention when no source exists.

lanes.name: dep-audit
lanes.description: Use before adding any third-party repo, package, or MCP server to a project - runs a two-stage supply-chain check covering metadata, secrets, known CVEs, code patterns, and anything that executes at install or build time. Free tools only, no account required.

lanes.name: master-repo-auto
lanes.description: Master Repo working rules - token discipline, compression safety, no-pruning policy, and multi-command handling. Load when compressing files, deciding what to load into context, orienting in an unfamiliar repository, or when asked how auto mode behaves.

lanes.name: retrieval-before-assert
lanes.description: Use before answering any question whose answer could have changed since training - library APIs, pricing, model names and versions, current best practice, repo state, prices, dates. Requires retrieving before answering rather than answering from memory.

lanes.name: scope-guard
lanes.description: Use when a request is ambiguous, underspecified, or larger than it first appears - prevents inventing requirements, silently narrowing scope, or expanding work beyond what was asked. Surfaces assumptions instead of burying them.

lanes.name: self-consistency-check
lanes.description: Use for high-stakes answers where being wrong is expensive - financial figures, security verdicts, medical or legal facts, irreversible operations, load-bearing architectural decisions. Samples the reasoning more than once and reconciles disagreement instead of trusting one pass.

lanes.name: verify-before-complete
lanes.description: Use before claiming any work is done, fixed, passing, deployed, or working - requires running the actual check and quoting real output. Blocks success claims that rest on inference rather than evidence.

setupRecipes.name: Master Repo global AI setup
setupRecipes.detail: Clones or refreshes Master-Repo-Use and installs its global client pointers.

commands.windows: $p=Join-Path $HOME 'Master-Repo-Use'; if (Test-Path (Join-Path $p '.git')) { git -C $p pull --ff-only } else { git clone https://github.com/Charlesganu2004/Master-Repo-Use.git $p }; & (Join-Path $p 'scripts/setup-global-ai.ps1') -RepoPath $p
commands.wsl: p="$HOME/Master-Repo-Use"; if [ -d "$p/.git" ]; then git -C "$p" pull --ff-only; else git clone https://github.com/Charlesganu2004/Master-Repo-Use.git "$p"; fi && bash "$p/scripts/setup-global-ai.sh" "$p"
commands.macos: p="$HOME/Master-Repo-Use"; if [ -d "$p/.git" ]; then git -C "$p" pull --ff-only; else git clone https://github.com/Charlesganu2004/Master-Repo-Use.git "$p"; fi && bash "$p/scripts/setup-global-ai.sh" "$p"
commands.linux: p="$HOME/Master-Repo-Use"; if [ -d "$p/.git" ]; then git -C "$p" pull --ff-only; else git clone https://github.com/Charlesganu2004/Master-Repo-Use.git "$p"; fi && bash "$p/scripts/setup-global-ai.sh" "$p"
commands.other: p="$HOME/Master-Repo-Use"; if [ -d "$p/.git" ]; then git -C "$p" pull --ff-only; else git clone https://github.com/Charlesganu2004/Master-Repo-Use.git "$p"; fi && sh "$p/scripts/setup-global-ai.sh" "$p"

routes.name: Local first, hosted on miss
routes.detail: Small local model answers; escalate only when it cannot.

routes.name: Local draft, hosted review
routes.detail: Local model drafts, hosted model reviews and corrects.

routes.name: Parallel then vote
routes.detail: Several models answer independently; disagreement triggers a third.

routes.name: Skeleton then retrieve
routes.detail: rtt maps the repo, the model retrieves only what it names.

routes.name: Compress then forward
routes.detail: Compress context locally before spending hosted tokens.

routes.name: Guarded write
routes.detail: Any deletion passes the hook before the model acts.

routes.name: Audit then approve
routes.detail: Deterministic audit proposes; the owner approves by passcode.

routes.name: Multimodal split
routes.detail: Vision to a multimodal model, reasoning to a text model.

routes.name: Budget capped
routes.detail: Stop and report rather than silently overspending a token target.

routes.name: Fully offline
routes.detail: No hosted call at any stage. Quality is bounded by the machine.

hardware.label: 4 GB RAM
hardware.detail: Local inference will swap and thrash. That is the honest answer, not a limit to engineer around.

hardware.label: 8 GB RAM
hardware.detail: 3B class models at 4-bit quantization, with headroom left for the OS.

hardware.label: 16 GB RAM
hardware.detail: 7B to 8B class at 4-bit. The common developer laptop.

hardware.label: 32 GB RAM
hardware.detail: 13B to 14B class, or 7B at higher precision.

hardware.label: Apple silicon
hardware.detail: GPU and CPU draw on one pool, so usable model size sits below the headline number. Metal acceleration is automatic in Ollama.

hardware.label: Discrete GPU
hardware.detail: System RAM does not substitute. A 12 GB card runs roughly what a 16 GB unified machine runs.
